subject: Who drafts invoice? Auto-push to portal vs. emailed PDF
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@stellon.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@stellon.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify who creates the invoice + delivery (portal vs email)

Hi Priyom and Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — Stellon is close to a purchase order but our AP team needs to confirm invoice flow before we lock the PO. Two quick items: 1) who will be the invoice originator (your side or ours)? We need the originator for VAT evidence, and 2) delivery method: we prefer an automated push to our AP portal (SFTP / webhook / API) but can accept emailed PDFs as a fallback.

Our requirements: PO field (PO-64412) in the invoice, VAT ID + reverse-charge flag when applicable, and a 5-business-day acknowledgement window after delivery. Also, please include the expected remittance details for SEPA payments.

I attached our AP spec (APspec_v2.pdf) so your ops team can check compatibility. Can Redwood push invoices automatically, and if so, what data formats do you support? If you need us to accept emailed PDFs instead, what is the recommended subject/body layout so our parser picks up metadata reliably?

Appreciate a short proposal — we are trying to avoid manual PDF uploads across multiple legal entities.

Best,
Lydia
Lydia Park
Head of Procurement | Stellon Therapeutics
lydia.park@stellon.com
(415) 555-1189

[attachment: APspec_v2.pdf (referenced)]

From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@stellon.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify who creates the invoice + delivery (portal vs email)

Hi Lydia — thanks for the spec and the clear list. Quick summary of options from our side:

1) Redwood-originated invoice (recommended): Redwood generates the invoice PDF/XML as the originator and pushes it directly to your portal (we support JSON webhook, SFTP drop with UBL/XML, and an invoice XML schema). Advantages: consistent VAT metadata, signing/traceability, and easier audit logs.

2) Customer-originated (Stellon drafts): We can accept your invoice files and reconcile against Redwood usage, but this requires a PO-first workflow and a short onboarding window to validate your XML/PDF format.

Operational notes: if we originate the invoice, we can include PO-64412, VAT ID, reverse-charge flag, SEPA remittance fields, and a machine-readable tax block. We propose a 3-stage acceptance flow: test push -> pilot month -> full auto-push.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm Redwood as originator (yes/no)
- Confirm preferred transport (webhook JSON, SFTP XML, or emailed PDF fallback)
- Agree on the 5-business-day ack window (we can emit automatic read/ack receipts)

I attached a lightweight invoice template (invoice_template_v1.pdf) and a short mutual action plan draft. If you confirm originator + portal push, we will schedule a 1-hour ops touchpoint next week to run a test push.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

[attachments: invoice_template_v1.pdf (stub), mutual_action_plan.docx (stub)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@stellon.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T13:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify who creates the invoice + delivery (portal vs email)

Priyom / Lydia — ops note from billing side: we strongly prefer Redwood to remain the invoice originator for the first 12 months of the engagement. Reason: tax evidence continuity and easier reconciliation across multi-entity customers.

Operational details to accept:
- We'll generate both PDF and machine XML for each invoice. Default push will be: 1) webhook JSON (primary) with signed payload + SFTP XML (secondary) for your AP ingestion. We can also send an emailed PDF copy to ap-team@stellon.com as a fallback.
- VAT fields: we will send VAT ID, VAT amount line, and reverse-charge boolean as separate fields. Please confirm the VAT ID format you expect (EU vs. domestic).
- Acknowledgement window: 5 business days sounds fine. Billing will reopen disputes after that window if no ack is received.

Timeline proposal (simple):
- Day 0: confirm originator + transport method
- Day 3: ops touchpoint and test push (we'll push a test invoice with PO-TEST-000)
- Day 7: pilot (first live invoice)
- Day 30: review reconciliation results and confirm full rollout

Ben — can you confirm we have the XML schema and a test webhook token ready?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@stellon.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:11:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify who creates the invoice + delivery (portal vs email)

Kim / team — confirmed. I've attached a sample XML that matches our invoice emitter schema (sample_invoice_xml.xml). It includes: invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, poNumber, buyerVatId, sellerVatId, line-level VAT %, reverseChargeFlag, and remittanceBlock for SEPA.

We also have a temporary webhook token we can use for the test push; ops will rotate it post-pilot. Action items from our side:
- I will provision a webhook token and SFTP creds in our staging cluster.
- Priyom, can you lock calendar for a 30-min ops touchpoint on Nov 24 or Nov 25?

Attaching sample_invoice_xml.xml (stub).

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

[attachment: sample_invoice_xml.xml (stub)]

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@stellon.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-23T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify who creates the invoice + delivery (portal vs email)

Thanks — Stellon confirms the following:
- Preference: Redwood-originated invoice, auto-push to our portal (webhook JSON primary; SFTP XML secondary).
- AP contact: ap-team@stellon.com (please send test push to that address and to our staging webhook endpoint — I will DM the URL to Ben).
- VAT: include buyer VAT ID and seller VAT ID as separate fields; include reverseCharge flag if reverse charge applies.
- Acknowledgement: we accept a 5-business-day ack window.

We'll expect the test push on Nov 24. Please include PO-64412 in the test-metadata so we can validate parsing rules. Once the test is OK, we'll sign the mutual action plan and move to pilot.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Lydia
Head of Procurement | Stellon Therapeutics

[Note: Lydia attached the AP spec they referenced earlier and requested the test webhook details over DM for security]
